name: Bark
overview: Suno's transformer-based audio model. While it generates speech, it is uniquely capable of generating non-verbal acoustic cues.
details: Bark diverges from traditional TTS by acting as a highly generative audio language model. It can hallucinate non-verbal sounds, such as laughs, sighs, music, and background ambient noise directly from text prompts.
This makes it a unique hybrid acoustic engine, although its lack of fine-grained control over foley generation makes dedicated models preferable for precise sound design.
